meaning:
ἀν-ήκω
(ἀνά, ἥκω), [in LXX: Jos.23:14 (בּוֹא), 1Ki.27:8, Sir. prol.10, 1, 2 Mac6* ;]
prop., to have come up to; in later writers, impers. it is due, it is befitting: in ethical sense (MM, VGT, see word), Eph.5:4, Col.3:18; τὸ ἀνῆκον, Phm 8.†
(AS)

elsewhere.note: nor filthiness, nor foolish talking, nor jesting, which are not appropriate, but rather giving of thanks.
Wives, be in subjection to your husbands, as is fitting in the Lord.
Therefore though I have all boldness in Christ to command you that which is appropriate,
